title: eludite/test/cancel
description: Cancel a discovery or run (the last started when `runId` is omitted). MTP: `$/cancelRequest` for the test application's `testing/discoverTests` or `testing/runTests` (Microsoft.Testing.Platform has no cancel method of its own), then the application's process tree is killed when it has not answered within 2 s (test frameworks cancel between tests, so a long test would otherwise finish first). VSTest: `TestExecution.Cancel` (or `TestDiscovery.Cancel`), then vstest.console's process tree is killed when the run has not completed within 2 s. Its `finished` update follows with state canceled.

runId.description: The discovery's or run's id, unique within one host process, from 1 (discoveries and runs share one counter).

canceled.description: Whether a discovery or run was running and is being canceled.
